claims.disproof_condition: 條件：鉅橡月營收或年報顯示墊板營收轉為年減、或高階載板客戶改用他家；或柳鑫等對手的一手資料寫出在台灣高階載板鑽孔取得份額。核查頻率：每月（月營收）＋每年（年報）。觸發後 48 小時：這條 claim 降 confidence，重讀蓋墊板層讀圖。
claims.statement: Aurona Industries' FY2025 annual report (self-reported): backup boards were 55.57% of 2025 revenue of NT$1.313 billion (phenolic boards 18.84%, other 25.59%); its main revenue is entry and backup boards for PCB / FPC drilling and backup boards for CCL cutting; revenue was NT$1.387, 1.374, 1.135, 1.258 and 1.313 billion in 2021-2025; no customer reached 10% of sales; it calls itself Taiwan's largest phenolic-resin laminate maker with no competitor yet in substrate, HDI and high-frequency applications, and says demand for high-end substrates (ABF, BT) is growing steadily with AI and HPC.
